notes.title: Update Announcement 11/21/2024
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Thank you for your continued love and support for "Raiders of Treasure Island". We understand that every update is an important step in our shared journey, and we hope these small adjustments will enhance your adventure experience even further.

1. We have added new skills and updated the abilities for the Priest class.
2. We have also adjusted the event schedule, and Season 1 has officially begun!
3. The difficulty of the dungeons has been adjusted, making battles a bit more challenging.
4. We’ve introduced a free-view camera mode, and we hope you enjoy it.

Please note that after this update, all data will be wiped. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the maintenance and data reset.
We will continue listening to each and every player’s feedback, constantly optimizing and improving the game to ensure that "Raiders of Treasure Island" becomes the ideal adventure haven in your hearts. Once again, thank you for your patience and understanding. We look forward to even more exciting adventures together!

Raiders of Treasure Island Team

notes.title: Update Announcement 6/28/2024
notes.content:
[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

Thank you for your continued love and support for "Raiders of Treasure Island." We understand that each update is an important step in our journey together. Hoping these subtle adjustments will make your adventure even more exciting.

[b]Combat Experience:[/b]
1. More Intuitive Looting: Now you can quickly acquire loot during battles without the hassle of precise aiming, making the battle rhythm more seamless.
2. Flexible Health Potion Use: You can now swiftly restore your health at any moment during combat, ensuring you can always forge ahead with courage.
[b]Guidance System:[/b]
1. Adjusted Feature Unlocks: We've tuned the pacing of feature unlocks to ensure that as your character grows, new features are introduced in a timely manner to enhance your adventure.
2. Optimized New Player Guidance: The positions and routes for new player guidance have been optimized to provide clearer directions, making your start smoother.
3. Streamlined New Player Process: We've simplified the new player guidance process, reducing the steps so new players can quickly immerse themselves in the game and enjoy the adventure.
4. Redesigned Dialog Guides: The dialog guide has been redesigned, with an owl acting as your guide to help you understand the game in a more friendly manner.
5. Improved Dialog Box Positioning: We've adjusted the positioning of dialog boxes to no longer obstruct your view, allowing you to focus more on the game.
6. Subtle Tips in Less Obvious Areas: We've added helpful hints in some less obvious areas to provide you with more thoughtful assistance.
[b]Item Interface:[/b]
1. Optimized Skill Book Names: The display of skill book names has been optimized, allowing you to more intuitively understand the type of skills and choose those that better match your combat style.
2. Adjusted Gift Pack Interface: The gift pack interface has been adjusted to more accurately display the quality of the packs, helping you make more informed choices.

We will continue to listen to the voices of every player, constantly optimizing and improving to ensure "Raiders of Treasure Island" becomes the ideal adventure paradise in everyone's heart. Thank you again for your patience and understanding. Let's look forward to even more exciting adventures together!

Sincerely,
Raiders of Treasure Island Team

notes.title: Update Announcement 6/14/2024
notes.content:
Dear Players,

After a period of adjustments, we have made some refinements to the drop details in "Raiders of Treasure Island" We are also working diligently on other improvements, so please bear with us a bit longer. Thank you for your patience. Below are the details of the latest update:

Gameplay Enhancements
1. New High-Level Chests: We have added new high-level chests in the cemetery map. These chests offer very rich drops, encouraging exploration.
2. Boss Room Adjustments: We've made slight adjustments to the terrain in some boss rooms to provide a better combat experience.
3. Attribute Rebalance: We have recalculated some attribute formulas and removed some unnecessary attributes to simplify and enhance the game system.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding of  Raiders of Treasure Island. Your participation and feedback drive our ongoing improvements!

Enjoy the game!

Raiders of Treasure Island Team

notes.title: Update Announcement 5/31/2024
notes.content:
[b]Dear players[/b]

We have made some adjustments to the game. The game will be updated on 5/31/2024, and all in-game accounts will undergo a data wipe. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

[b]Update Content：[/b]

[b]Season Related[/b]
1. After the season update, ranks will be downgraded to Dust Minion to start the new season.
2. A new season pack will be available in the store.
3. The merchant system has been restructured to support time-controlled item listings.
4. Features like leaderboards and the trading house will be reset with the season update.
5. Rewards not claimed before the season handbook expires will be sent to players via mail.
[b]Ranks[/b]
1. Rank maps will now match players of similar ranks into a game based on their character's rank.
2. Enhanced visual effects for rank promotion/demotion.
3. Added a rank protection mechanism: when rank points drop to 0, the rank will not immediately drop. The rank will only drop if points are deducted again in the next game.
[b]Merchants[/b]
1. Introduced a new merchant type—Class Mentor. Players can now purchase skill books for their respective classes from these mentors to learn new skills.
2. Added a bulk purchase feature, allowing players to buy multiple items at once from merchants.
3. Improved potion purchasing experience: the uncertified doctor now offers bundled potions for travelers' convenience.
[b]Beginner Quests[/b]
1. Adjusted the difficulty of beginner quests for a smoother learning curve.
2. Added new rewards for beginner quests to help characters level up more quickly.
[b]Seasonal Activities[/b]
1. The seasonal event will be divided into two phases. The first phase will start from 5/27 and last until late July. The opening of subsequent phases will depend on actual circumstances.
2. Two new gameplay mechanics, overgrown weeds and gramophone, will be introduced in the first phase. Detailed information can be found in the seasonal event interface.
3. Seasonal tasks will be available to complement the new mechanics in the first phase, allowing characters to complete tasks and earn resource rewards while experiencing the new mechanics.
[b]New Player Guidance[/b]
1. Introduced the New Player Guide 1.0. New players can quickly learn the game mechanics through a simple introductory level.
[b]Season Handbook[/b]
1. Added the Season Handbook activity. During the event, characters will earn handbook experience for each dungeon battle. Accumulating enough experience will increase the handbook level, granting rare rewards.
[b]Skill System[/b]
1. Added unlock level prompts for skill slots.
2. Improved skill learning prompts. Icons for learnable skills will now be more prominent when players have the corresponding skill books.
[b]Combat[/b]
1. Modified the unlock levels for skills and skill slots.
2. Added numerous skill book skills for all classes, which can be gradually unlocked through purchase or boss drops.
3. Adjusted basic skills for some weapons and initial skills for some classes.
4. Optimized the in-game reticle and indicator displays.
5. Improved the in-game movement algorithm for smoother movement.
6. Fixed bugs causing some skill effect icons to display incorrectly in-game.
7. Fixed errors or ambiguities in some skill text descriptions.


Thank you for your support and understanding.

"Raiders of Treasure Island" Team

notes.title: Update Announcement 04/30/2024
notes.content:
Dear Players，

We are releasing a new class: Priest. Now you can choose to be a priest. New skills for priest are actively being developed. 
After clearing a dungeon, all items obtained will be displayed in the settlement. We have optimized the portal experience, now it will immediately teleport once the voting ends. 
The enchantment UI has been optimized. 
Now you can send signal markers on the map with the map opened. 
The high-intensity monsters in dungeons now possess a broader range of skills.

Thank you for your participation and understanding.


"Raiders of Treasure Island" Team

notes.title: Update Announcement 4/18/2024
notes.content:
[b]Dear players,[/b]

After a period of adjustment, the game has undergone some significant changes. The updates are as follows:

[b]Dungeon Matchmaking:[/b]
1. Optimized the matchmaking mechanism. Now the Lakeside Town map can be played solo, and the Kings’ Mausoleum map only requires 3 players to enter.
[b]Team Recruitment:[/b]
1. We have updated the team function. Now you can find the team list and join by clicking on it through the chat panel.
2. Added a quick join feature to help players join other teams faster.
3. Optimized the team invitation interface. Now received team invitations will be highlighted more prominently.
[b]Bag and warehouse:[/b]
1. Optimized the display of tips, added equipment ratings, so now you can better compare equipment.
2. Adjusted bag and warehouse operations, removed the hover display of item tips, and changed it to click on the item to pop up tips.
3. Adjusted item function buttons and moved them above the tips for easier operation.
4. Added item quality display. Now all items have a frame corresponding to their quality to better distinguish the rarity of different items.
5. We made some adjustments to grid size for all items, so now the way items are placed in bag and warehouse is more reasonable.
[b]Character Creation:[/b]
1. Modified the initial equipment given. Now the given equipment has higher attributes and strength for better confrontation against enemies.
2. Optimized the character creation interface and removed the restriction on same names. Now players can create multiple characters with the same name.
[b]Merchant:[/b]
1. Adjusted the number of merchants. Now merchants will unlock one by one according to the level, and each will sell higher strength equipment.
[b]Commission system:[/b]
1. Added commission red dot reminder. Now there will be a red dot reminder when there are rewards that can be claimed.
[b]Loot pickup:[/b]
1. Optimized the experience of picking up dropped items in the dungeon, now it's easier and more accurate to pick up items on the ground.
2. Adjusted the way loot drops from monsters. Now, after a monster dies, its loot will drop on the ground as neutral items for players to pick up.
[b]Player Information:[/b]
1. Adjusted the player information interface. Now you can see the target player's name, level, attributes, and other information.
2. Fixed the bug of historical records not updating in real-time.
[b]Skill Learning:[/b]
1. Optimized the skill learning interface. Now all skills that the character can learn and obtain can be viewed in one interface.
2. Adjusted the skill learning operation. Now you can quickly load and unload skills by right-clicking on the skill icon.
[b]Reconnection:[/b]
1. Added a reconnection system. After unexpectedly closing the game during combat, you can reconnect to the dungeon to avoid unnecessary loss of items.
[b]Mini Map:[/b]
1. Added a mini map. Now you can open the map during combat to view teammate positions, boss positions, teleportation directions, and other location information.
[b]Class Adjustment: [/b]
Rebalanced the damage of all classes. 
Optimized the overall combat action speed and skill coherence. 
Optimized the skill unlocking process. 
Optimized the skill casting process, added skill indicators for some skills. 
Fixed some skill text description errors. 
Added new skills for all classes.
[b]Warrior: [/b]
Redesigned the standard skills of the warrior. Now newly created warriors will default to equipping a greatsword, removing the charging system, and completely redoing the warrior's skills. 
Optimized the operation experience of movement skills. 
Fixed the bug where melee attacks sometimes couldn't hit the target.
[b]Wizard: [/b]
Redesigned the standard skills of the wizard. 
Redesigned the wizard's basic attack. 
Optimized the skill casting experience of the wizard, reducing the number of chanting skills. 
Optimized the number of skills, now wizards and other classes can carry 4 skills.
[b]Musket: [/b]
Added headshot mechanics. 
Optimized the shooting experience of muskets. 
Optimized the aiming display during shooting. 
Optimized the calculation rules for bullet flight paths.

[b]Combat Optimization: [/b]
Added player name and health display. 
Added skill status refresh prompt. 
Added text prompt for skill restrictions. 
Optimized the combat interface UI. 
Optimized character collision rules. 
Optimized sprinting function, now characters will automatically enter sprinting state after leaving combat.
Optimized hit feedback for characters and scene objects. 
Optimized off-site skill configuration. 
Optimized overall logic of waiting lobby. 
Fixed numerous skill performance bugs.

Thanks for your participation and understanding.
Sincerely, 

"Raiders of Treasure Island" Team

notes.title: A letter from the developers
notes.content:
To all players:

Dear Players and Adventurers,

Greetings to all! This is a letter from the developers of "Raiders of Treasure Island".
First and foremost, we are profoundly grateful that you have chosen to play our game, "Raiders of Treasure Island". For us, who are just starting out, this means tremendous support and encouragement.
Following this, please accept the sincere apologies from our development team! Many of you have encountered various issues during gameplay, leading to numerous unpleasant experiences. We are deeply sorry for this and are open to all criticisms and suggestions. We will make our utmost efforts to modify and optimize the game, aiming to ensure that every player, whether opening the game for the first time or returning, can have a better experience and more fun.

At the same time, we welcome everyone to leave their most honest reviews about the game, as it will serve as a driving force for the continuous growth of the development team!
Although our team members come from different parts of the world, we have been able to come together through our shared passion for gaming and have decided to create a game that our players love. Now, having taken this small step, we have had the opportunity to meet and connect with you, our player friends. We will continue to work hard on development and regularly update with more and better game content.

At the beginning of March, the team completed the trial version of the game, which still has many issues. We are working on emergency fixes and updating the version daily. If you encounter any problems or bugs during the game, please let us know. We will address and process all the feedback promptly.

Here are some of the current development progresses from our team, which we would like to share with our player friends:
- We have introduced 4 classes and will continue to add new weapons and skills to those classes in future updates.
- We have 2 maps ready for players to explore and plan to open up a third map within the next four weeks. We will also introduce different gameplay modes in future updates.
- In response to the feedback we received from many players who struggled with the game’s learning curve, we are working on adding beginner guides that will help our players get acquainted with the game in the next two weeks.
- New equipments, monsters, and bosses will gradually be introduced in upcoming updates...
If you are interested in "Raiders of Treasure Island" and its developers, or if you would like to provide any gameplay feedback, feel free to contact us through the team's social media accounts below.

twitter（X）：https://twitter.com/PLAYROTI

Reddit：https://www.reddit.com/r/PLAYROTI/

QQ Group：733080322
Email：SuperMonsterCS@gmail.com


Once again, we sincerely apologize and thank you for all the support.

"Raiders of Treasure Island" Team
